name: VRM Retro Viewer (VRM avatar to pixel sprites + Pyxel 3D)
summary: Free browser tool: drop a VRM 0.x/1.0 avatar (VRoid etc.), animate it with 231 bundled CC0 motions (Quaternius UAL 1&2, KayKit) and export transparent 8- or 4-direction sprite sheets (PNG + GIF, 32-128 px) or Pyxel 3 3D data with a loader. You can add your own FBX/VRMA motions. Runs locally in the page (Pyodide), no upload, no install; full source on GitHub.

access.notes: Tool code MIT; bundled motions CC0. Exported sprites follow your VRM's own license (tool shows it and warns). Added Mixamo motions keep Mixamo terms. Provided AS IS. Desktop browser.

procedure: Open the itch.io page on a desktop browser and click Run tool (or press Try sample).
Drop your .vrm file; pick a motion from the 231 CC0 motions (or add .fbx/.vrma).
Choose size, 4/8 directions and fps, then export sprite sheets (PNG + GIF) or Pyxel 3D ZIP.
Optional: download the MIT source from GitHub and run it on your desktop.

verdict.why: First-party new drop (108 likes, 67 bookmarks in <1 day): turns any VRM into game-ready pixel sprites with 231 CC0 motions, free, local, MIT source. Repo itself is brand new (0 stars).
